description: SPENDS CREDITS: turns a quote into a job group, reserving up to its total_ceiling_credits. Ask the user first. Pass quote_ref as quote returned it, restate its total as expected_total_credits (a disagreement is refused and nothing is sent), and a fresh idempotency_key, reused on retry so nothing spends twice.

expected_total_credits.description: The total_ceiling_credits the quote showed, in your own words.

idempotency_key.description: Printable ASCII, 1 to 255 characters; reuse it to retry this confirm.

quote_ref.description: confirm_with.quote_ref from the quote tool's answer, verbatim.

name: confirm
title: Confirm a quote (spends credits)
